_doc: The top-level design. The lead owns this file: includes, buses and master. Each designer owns one fragment in audio/design/. Keys that start with _ are comments.
_buses_doc: music: down 6 dB under the typing (2.0-2.9 s) so the keys read, back up for the transition, +1.5 dB into the drop at 8.0 s, 3 dB lower under the logo from 10.0 s. Every step sits on a splice or under a transient. amb and sfx stay at 0.
_master_doc: -14 LUFS integrated with a true-peak ceiling of 0.77 linear gives about -1 dBTP after AAC. Use -15 or -16 only with a written reason, for example a dynamic orchestral track that the limiter would flatten.
